recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-19766 unless a future terminology decision changes the CareTeam category content rather than the already-correct enumeration structure.
issue_request: FHIR-19766 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for FHIR-core CareTeam asking to fix the CareTeam.category value set by enumerating the LOINC codes instead of using concept-property filters.
initial_application: Commit 63ffc078cc8b9a13a1fa99cb973c3ae8b23cfe93, merged by 4e84c2b6d36f9fb398786998f9e891b973cd5dcc, applied the request by replacing LOINC concept is-a filters in source/careteam/valueset-care-team-category.xml with one LOINC include containing explicit concept entries. Later source rework and terminology metadata commits preserved the explicit concept list.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes careteam=CareTeam, and CareTeam.category binds to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/care-team-category. The current value set contains eight explicit LOINC concepts with no filters. A 2020 Zulip thread reporting that the rendered value set contained 0 concepts was answered by the original editor as fixed in the latest build per J#19766. Patient Care minutes record GF#19766 discussion on the Jira vote date. FHIR-15962 established the LOINC answer-code content that FHIR-19766 corrected structurally; it was treated as background rather than a separate decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the active current source already satisfies the requested filter-to-enumeration correction and the inspected XML parses cleanly.
